args.subject: Quotation BCX-Q-2609 - confirmation of name change, part numbers and origin
args.body:
Hello Brian,

Thank you for your 2 September note and quotation BCX-Q-2609 for 2027. Before we use it, we need a few things from you.

1. Name and address change: please confirm the change from Baycrest Connectors to BCX Interconnect and the Ardenmoor Industrial Group acquisition through your usual contact with us. Until our buyer has confirmed this with you directly, we will keep sending purchase orders and correspondence to the contact we have on file.

2. Part numbers: the quotation lists eleven items without Halden part numbers. Please send the Halden part number, or your own part number and description, for each item 1 to 11, with the unit each price is quoted in.

3. Origin and tariff: please send the country of origin for each line, the HTS classification you use for each, and a certificate of origin for the lines built at Dongguan.

4. Open orders: please confirm that the promised dates on our open PO lines with you are unchanged. We are not asking for any change to them.

The quotation shows prices valid to 30 November 2026. This is a request for information only and does not commit Halden to any order or price. Please reply as soon as you can.

Regards,
Priya Nair
Halden Robotics

recommendation.finding: Brian Tanaka says Baycrest Connectors was acquired by Ardenmoor Industrial Group and became BCX Interconnect on 1 September. He sends 2027 quotation BCX-Q-2609 on Net 30, DDP Reno terms, valid to 30 November 2026. BCX Interconnect is already linked as the same supplier. I've staged one reply to the contact on file, not to Tanaka's own address. It asks him to confirm the rename and the address change, match the eleven quoted items to part numbers, give origin and a certificate of origin for the Dongguan lines, and confirm the open PO dates are unchanged. It makes no award or promise. His address is not the contact on file and he asks for orders to go to a new address, so Priya Nair should phone the contact on file to confirm before any order or remittance change. She should also check the bank and remit-to details on the vendor master, not take them from the email.
assumptions: The rename and the Ardenmoor acquisition are the supplier's claim until the contact on file confirms them.
would_change: A phone confirmation from the contact on file would clear the rename and the new orders address.
The origin per line from the quote attachment would settle the Dongguan duty question.
